programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: C'est l'élection des Miss Zoo : Autruche, Grue, Cigogne. L'Autruche a la tête verte, sa laque remplacée par de la peinture. Qui est responsable ? Sherlock, lui, a les cheveux roses à cause d'un shampoing raté. L'éléphant, arroseur des voisins, voit sa trompe bouchée par deux bananes. Hermine est agacée par le désordre de Sherlock, qui ne retrouve plus rien.

programme.title: L'incroyable Noël de Grabouillon : Bananouille et Bagoutar
programme.desc: Grabouillon, un chien gaffeur, est le compagnon de jeu de Pétunia, une petite fille plutôt sage qu'il entraîne dans ses bêtises. D'autres animaux les suivent.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu donne des conseils à RNS pour qu'il fasse des progrès en ski. Il devient aussi bon... voire meilleur qu'elle... Lulu n'apprécie pas.RNS se fait passer pour éclopé pour se soustraire à la corvée labourage du potager. Mais Lulu et les copains lui font croire qu'un trésor est enfoui sous la terre qu'ils sont en train de retourner...

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: Boa gagne le trophée musical, mais on lui vole après la cérémonie. Qui parmi les concurrents est coupable ? Pendant ce temps, Hermine cache à Sherlock qu'elle a planqué sa cornemuse. Sherlock est épuisé : quelqu'un l'appelle toutes les nuits pour le harceler. Hermine doit gérer ce détective fatigué et réveiller son génie.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon parie avec Pétunia de ne pas faire de bêtises jusqu'au coucher du soleil, mais Bagou lui tend des pièges. Poussé à bout, il goûte un gâteau interdit et invente une crise de somnambulisme. Lors d'un quiz, il devient super intelligent grâce à un champignon, mais sa vanité inquiète Pétunia. Fatigué, il fabrique un radeau, espérant convaincre Bagou de l'aider.

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Vipkrad inonde Atalantis pour faire remonter un fragment de miroir. Marcus doit réparer les canalisations, mais, trop pressé, il ignore Sybilin et doit rebrousser chemin. Puis, il doit voler le trésor du pirate Bicrochet avant Vipkrad. Marcus, fan de pirates, se prend pour l'un d'eux, mais son orgueil met la mission en danger.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Quand Pétunia ramène Bidul, Grabouillon jaloux pousse Bagou à le chasser. Pétunia le tient responsable et il doit protéger Bidul. Grabouillon et Bagou font du kart, mais les enfants rentrent tôt. Privés, ils apprennent le code de la route. Jaloux, Grabouillon sabote l'art de Pétunia, puis devient modèle. Fatigué, il fait des bêtises qui inquiètent Pétunia.

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: Quelqu'un a commandé une armoire à Mr Hippo… puis a disparu ! Arnaque ? Sherlock enquête. De son côté, Hermine offre un portable à Sherlock, qui galère avec la technologie. Pendant ce temps, Cigogne, experte en savoir-vivre, est ridiculisée en direct à la télé. Phacochère, Grizzli ou Pélican ? Les suspects sont tous de sacrés malpolis !

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: Enlevé par Robin des Bois, pourchassé dans un opéra, interrompu par Elvis alors qu'il tente de contacter un extra-terrestre, Coda finit sur un tremplin de ski, persuadé de pouvoir rentrer chez lui. Mais entre tirs à l'arc douteux, rats agressifs, ondes saturées et vols ratés, son retour tourne, une fois de plus, à la catastrophe !

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon tache le T-shirt préféré de Pétunia, vexé il part à l'aventure mais découvre vite qu'il est plutôt un toutou d'intérieur. Pétunia lui met une collerette contre une allergie, ce qui l'agace. Fasciné par Tatouwak, il cherche un animal totem. Après une pêche ratée avec ses amis, il tente seul le gros poisson, mais la mer est dure.

programme.title: Petites Poules
programme.desc: Pour l'anniversaire de Carmélito, Carmen cherche une idée… Quand Marco Polo arrive avec ses feux d'artifice, c'est parfait ! Mais Coquenpâte et Bangcoq volent la poudre et causent une explosion. Le soir, le spectacle a lieu malgré tout. Plus tard, les rats volent les œufs de Coquillette. Avec l'aide de Robin des Bois, nos héros les sauvent juste à temps pour l'éclosion !

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Ni Oui a peur d'assister à l'envol des éphémères, qui ne vivent qu'une nuit. Lulu veut faire un exposé sur les cucurbitacées, mais la maîtresse choisit Frou-Frou, qui en a moins fait. Lulu est déçue, mais décide d'aider son amie à préparer son exposé et à surmonter son trac.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon se blesse et doit porter une collerette, ce qui le rend grognon. Il échange avec Bagout pour se gratter, mais doit patienter. Ensuite, il fait tomber une lettre précieuse, qu'il remplace maladroitement. Il craint aussi le vaccin, cache son carnet, puis découvre que c'est pour Pétunia. Enfin, un yaourt périmé cause une course-poursuite avec la taupe.

programme.title: Gibby perd son sang froid
programme.desc: Gibby est persuadé que Freddie est intéressé par sa nouvelle petite amie. Il lui propose alors de le défier au cours d'un combat, que Sam décide de diffuser en direct dans l'émission de Carly.

programme.title: LAmour perdu de Lewbert
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie découvrent que Lewbert avait une petite amie et qu'il était heureux. Ils décident de retrouver Marta en espérant qu'elle lui apportera à nouveau le bonheur. Mais la vie n'est pas toujours comme on l'imagine...

programme.title: Le concours de beauté
programme.desc: Sam révèle à Carly et Freddie avoir participé à un concours de beauté lorsqu'elle était plus jeune.

programme.title: Le rendez-vous de Spencer
programme.desc: Sam se retrouve accidentellement en prison et Carly et Freddie font leur possible pour que l'émission ait lieu malgré tout. Ils demandent alors l'aide de Spencer, qui a malheureusement un rendez-vous ce soir là.

programme.title: dans lespace
programme.desc: iCarly se voit proposer de tourner un web show exceptionnel dans l'Espace grâce à un milliardaire qui souhaite promouvoir un nouveau concept de voyage spatial...

programme.title: Bigfoot
programme.desc: A la suite d'un reportage aux infos, Carly est bien décidée à prouver à tout le monde que BIGFOOT, un primate humanoïde, existe réellement.

programme.title: Freddie déménage!
programme.desc: Freddie ne supporte plus que ça mère le traite comme un bébé et déménage. Carly et Sam monte une affaire de photographie animalière, mais sont vite dérangées par d'autres photographes ne supportant pas la concurrence.

programme.title: Vague de chaleur
programme.desc: A cause de la vague de chaleur, la ville subit une panne de courant. Spencer, toujours plein da ressource, met en marche un générateur électrique et un climatiseur ultra performant.

programme.title: La psychopathe
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly doit se rendre au Webicône à Olympia, un festival qui réunit toutes les plus grandes stars du Web... Avant de partir, ils reçoivent un mail vidéo de Nora, une jeune fan désespérée et sans ami.

programme.title: La psychopathe
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly doit se rendre au Webicône à Olympia, un festival qui réunit toutes les plus grandes stars du Web... Avant de partir, ils reçoivent un mail vidéo de Nora, une jeune fan désespérée et sans ami.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Miranda, l'actrice qui joue le rôle d'iCarly convoque Jerry, le comédien jouant Spencer sur le plateau pour lui remonter les bretelles.

programme.title: Lanniversaire de Carly
programme.desc: C'est l'anniversaire de Carly, Spencer veut lui faire un cadeau original. Il fabrique une lampe avec des bonbons qui prend feu. La chambre de Carly brûle entièrement. Grâce à l'argent de l'assurance,

programme.title: Je le veux
programme.desc: Carly reçoit une demande originale : Gordon, un fan de l'émission, veut demander la main de sa petite amie, Jodi, en direct. Jodi accepte la demande en mariage et convie Carly et ses amis au mariage!

programme.title: Les Blaguo-shirts
programme.desc: Sam et Carly organisent une vente aux enchères avec tout un tas d'objets qui leur ont servi pendant l'émission iCarly. Le t-shirt rigolo remporte un succès.

programme.title: Le roi de la blague
programme.desc: Carly n'a jamais fait de blague et demande à Spencer de l'aider. Il fini par accepter, mais ses vieux démons le rattrapent. Lorsqu'il était en troisième, on l'appelait le roi de la blague, jusqu'au jour où.

programme.title: Ursli, l'enfant des montagnes
programme.desc: Un garçon doit braver la neige profonde de l'hiver pour obtenir un précieux souvenir de famille. Avant même de pouvoir commencer ce difficile voyage, il doit d'abord aider sa famille à survivre à la ruine financière, sauver sa chèvre bien-aimée...

programme.title: Lino
programme.desc: Lino, mascotte de fêtes pour enfants, déteste son costume de chat et la façon dont il est traité. Il consulte un magicien pour changer de vie, mais un sort tourne mal. À son réveil, il est piégé dans le costume qu'il voulait fuir.

programme.title: Zip & Zap
programme.desc: Zip et Zap, deux jumeaux très turbulents, toujours prêts à faire les quatre cents coups, sont punis et envoyés dans un camp d'été très particulier.

programme.title: The Secret Kingdom
programme.desc: Dans un manoir, deux enfants découvrent un royaume magique et partent en quête pour sauver une civilisation menacée.

programme.title: Blood Circus
programme.desc: Un ancien champion du monde de MMA se voit enrôlé dans un club de combat souterrain appelé « Blood Circus » et se retrouver forcé de se battre pour survivre et sauver sa famille.

programme.title: Dahmer le Cannibale
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie, Dahmer raconte l'histoire du célèbre serial-killer Jeffrey Dahmer.

programme.title: Bullet
programme.desc: Frank Marasco, surnommé « Bullet », est le flic le plus féroce de Los Angeles. Il s'apprête à partir à la retraite. Lorsque son petit-fils est kidnappé, il décide de se faire justice lui-même : il ne reculera devant rien pour le retrouver.

programme.title: The Deal
programme.desc: Dans une société totalitaire née après une pandémie dévastatrice, chaque citoyen doit accepter un contrat lui garantissant vingt ans de sécurité avant une mort programmée. À quelques jours de son échéance, Tala se lance dans un ultime combat pour empêcher sa fille de devenir à son tour prisonnière de ce système impitoyable.

programme.title: A battle of wits
programme.desc: Une fresque retraçant la série de guerres civiles qui construisit la nation chinoise du cinquième siècle au troisième siècle avant J-C.

programme.title: Kristy
programme.desc: Une jeune étudiante est prise au piège par une bande d'intrus qui s'est introduite sur le campus pendant les vacances de Thanksgiving...

programme.title: Ghost Stories
programme.desc: Le professeur Goodman, en enquêtant sur trois événements paranormaux effrayants, voit sa rationalité vaciller. Il se demande si son esprit lui joue des tours ou si des forces surnaturelles existent.

programme.title: Age of Heroes
programme.desc: La véritable histoire de l'unité de Ian Fleming, commando précurseur des troupes d'élites britanniques, qui changea le cours de la Seconde Guerre Mondiale.

programme.title: Baron rouge
programme.desc: Allemagne, Première Guerre mondiale : le célèbre pilote Manfred von Richthofen, alias Le Baron Rouge, tombe amoureux de Käte et réalise que son image sert la propagande.

programme.title: Limbo limbo travel
programme.desc: Dans un pays où les hommes semblent plus s'intéresser à leurs gadgets électroniques qu'à leurs semblables, un groupe de femmes solitaires et désillusionnées prend le Limbo Limbo Bus. En route pour un pays exotique lointain dans l'espoir d'y trouver le bonheur tant espéré.

programme.title: Terremere
programme.desc: Abdoulaye est un banlieusard d'une vingtaine d'années. Lorsqu'un de ses frères décède suite à un accident de la route, il se charge de transporter le corps jusqu'au village de ses parents en Mauritanie.

programme.title: Love, he said
programme.desc: 1973 - San Francisco, Charles Bukowski, poète underground et punk avant l'heure, lit son poème LOVE devant une salle déchaînée venue pour assister au spectacle des provocations du poète trash... et pourtant ce jour-là ce n'est pas un punk qui apparaît mais un homme brisé et affamé d'amour.

programme.title: Jamais Jamais
programme.desc: Week-end de Pâques, dans une ville de province. De permanence au commissariat, les lieutenants Françoise Ruiz et Clémentine Arpinon règlent les affaires courantes. L'ennui, de circonstance, éveille chez ces deux femmes que tout oppose une certaine envie d'en découdre. Une intervention pour tapage nocturne leur offre l'occasion de passer à l'acte.

programme.title: Fille du calvaire
programme.desc: Jérôme est tombé amoureux d'une jeune femme qu'il essaie de séduire. Jour après jour, il raconte l'évolution des opérations à son ami Patrick qui dispense ses conseils et vit par procuration les aventures de son cadet.

programme.title: Règlement de Conte
programme.desc: Mona et Hassan sont frère et soeur par alliance et ne s'entendent pas du tout. Ils sont envoyés dans un camp dirigé par le professeur de théâtre Melle Sankaré. Des les premières répétitions, une bagarre éclate entre eux. Punis, ils sont oubliés dans la foret. A leur réveil, ils ont changé de corps.

programme.title: Quelque chose brûle
programme.desc: Margot a des souvenirs, des idées noires qui la hantent et la mènent dans les montagnes de son enfance, chez son frère Adrien. Dans le froid de l'hiver le fantôme d'un frère disparu resurgit.

programme.title: La Plongeuse
programme.desc: Une plongeuse professionnelle s'entraîne intensément sous les coups de sifflets de son entraîneur. Epuisée, elle refuse de plonger une nouvelle fois et décide d'aller voir un masseur.

programme.title: De haute naissance
programme.desc: Le 12 juillet 1884, dans la demeure Modigliani, Garsin, un huissier et quatre policiers sont chargés de saisir tous les biens de la famille.

programme.title: Immobiles
programme.desc: “J'ai demandé à des gens que je ne connaissais pas, de poser totalement immobiles et de fixer l'objectif”. Des premiers clichés d'être humain au dispositif cinématographique, le film décline l'idée du portrait, à la fois arrêt du temps, représentation du vivant mais aussi expérience de la mort.

programme.title: La canne
programme.desc: Dans une salle de classe, les enfants attendent l'arrivée de leur nouvelle institutrice.

programme.title: Heurts
programme.desc: Fred, trente cinq ans, et Lisa, quarante cinq ans, s'aiment et essaient désespérément de faire un enfant. Mais en ce jour où Lisa fête son anniversaire et accuse la différence d'âge entre elle et Fred, celui-ci s'échappe pour une raison inconnue. Restée seule, Lisa va se laisser entraîner dans le tourbillon de son passé, et provoquer des heurts irrémédiables...

programme.title: Eric Rohmer et la pédagogie
programme.desc: Eric Rohmer, dans la salle de la Cinémamecque présente son court métrage « Véronique et son cancre » et sous une forme géométrique évoque les difficultés de la transmission et de la pédagogie.

programme.title: Blue
programme.desc: Une femme est éveillée la nuit. À proximité, un ensemble de décors de théâtre se niche, dévoilant deux paysages alternatifs. Sur le drap bleu de la femme, une lueur de lumière reflète et illumine son royaume d'insomnie.

programme.title: Breathing
programme.desc: Au lever du soleil, sur le toit de verre de la fondation, Aurélie Dupont interprète le solo « Ekstasis », chorégraphié par Martha Graham et ré-imaginé par Virginie Mécène. Une danse suspendue, entre ciel et mer, où la performance évolue à mesure que le jour se lève.

programme.title: Eclosion
programme.desc: Ce sont des cubes de pierre solitaires, usés et brisés, flottant dans la brume... Le temps du rassemblement est venu pour eux.

programme.title: Revulshk !
programme.desc: On voit toute une série de personnages lire le journal. Un article les interpelle et ils décident de manifester, de protester à leur manière. "J'avance le coeur léger mais toujours le poing levé" Amel Bent

programme.title: Cléo
programme.desc: Rien de plus banal qu'un divorce, sauf quand aucun des parents ne demande la garde de l'enfant. Cléo, dix ans, va fuir ce qui lui semble insupportable. Le sentiment d'abandon est un puissant moteur d'evasion.

programme.title: Miscellanées
programme.desc: Le soir tombe sur les montagnes du Queyras. Un être étrange apparaît dans la forêt et plante une graine qui fait naître un arbre au feuillage magique. Quand le jour se lève, une des petites feuilles entame alors un voyage qui animera toute la vallée.

programme.title: Premiers contacts
programme.desc: Tahiti : 1767. Une jeune fille observe les premiers échanges entre sa communauté et des européens venus par bateau. Petit à petit, leur présence altère son quotidien.

programme.title: La Pastèque
programme.desc: Un après-midi d'été, deux soeurs se chamaillent pour partager équitablement une demi pastèque.

programme.title: Dormir
programme.desc: Dans un appartement en pleine nuit, tout le monde dort tranquillement, sauf une adolescente tenue éveillée par les multiples petits bruits qui l'entourent.

programme.title: Dimanche matin
programme.desc: Tous les dimanches matin, Ann, une petite fille de 7 ans, est obligée de se lever tôt pour aller à l'église avec sa famille. Mais ce dimanche, cela ne se passe pas tout à fait comme prévu.

programme.title: Bigoudis
programme.desc: Dans une maison de retraite, l'ouverture d'un petit salon de coiffure réveille la vitalité de ses pensionnaires.

programme.title: Basav ! Chante !
programme.desc: Pieds nus sur les routes, les tziganes avancent toujours malgré le froid et les corbeaux, une guitare à la main.

programme.title: L'odeur des Plumerias
programme.desc: Au Laos, une adolescente française rencontre un novice bouddhiste. Lors d'une soirée, ils se rejoignent au karaoké.

programme.title: L'homme aux oiseaux
programme.desc: Dans un village de montagne bloqué par la neige, les habitants attendent la venue de l'Homme aux oiseaux, qui annonce la fin de l'hiver.

programme.title: Clapotis
programme.desc: Un après-midi d'hiver à la piscine...

programme.title: Service magique
programme.desc: Krishna, jeune touriste indien, va enfin vivre une journée de rêve à Lynsdéland, le célèbre et merveilleux parc d'attraction!

programme.title: Pedigree
programme.desc: Comme tous les enfants de son âge, Elias, 8 ans, va passer le test de "visio-prostérité".

programme.title: Never Back Down
programme.desc: Une femme est kidnappée et forcée de participer à des combats souterrains d'élite et doit se frayer un chemin vers la liberté.

programme.title: Double Frappe
programme.desc: Un baron de la drogue cible un agent infiltré du FBI et le tueur à gages dont elle tombe amoureuse lors de sa traque.

programme.title: Age of the Dragons
programme.desc: Le roman classique Moby Dick de Herman Melville est recréé dans un monde où le capitaine Achab et son équipage sont à la recherche d'un grand dragon blanc.

programme.title: Far away: les soldats de l'espoir
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie. Jun Shik travaille à la ferme du grand-père de Tatsuo alors que la Corée est colonisée par le Japon, mais il rêve de participer aux Jeux olympiques de Tokyo en tant que coureur de marathon. Tatsuo vise également à devenir marathonien, ce qui crée une rivalité entre eux. Mais la guerre éclate et ils sont tous deux forcés de s'enrôler dans l'armée. Tatsuo devient chef de la défense dans l'unité de Jun Shik et élabore un plan qui échoue. Jun Shik et Tatsuo sont capturés par les Soviétiques. Ils s'échappent mais sont rapidement capturés par les Allemands et forcés de se séparer. En 1944, ils se retrouvent sur les plages de Normandie.

programme.title: Don't Be Afraid Of The Dark
programme.desc: Alex, sa fille Sally, 8 ans, et sa compagne, Kim, s'installent au manoir de Blackwood, à Rhode Island. Dès la première nuit, Sally découvre le terrible secret de la maison. Des créatures hostiles hantent les lieux et se livrent chaque nuit à divers actes de malveillance. Mais Alex et Kim accusent Sally...

programme.title: The Exception
programme.desc: Hollande, 1940. Brandt, un jeune officier allemand ambitieux et patriote, est envoyé malgré lui en Hollande auprès de Guillaume II, Kaiser en exil, pour assurer sa protection. Il se laisse séduire et tombe amoureux de Mieke une jeune juive hollandaise au service du Kaiser. Les SS découvrent que la résistance a réussi à infiltrer un agent dans le repaire du kaiser pour l'assassiner et déstabiliser le régime d'Hitler. Brandt doit découvrir son identité. Entre trahison et jeu d'espion, très vite, il va découvrir qu'il devra lui aussi choisir entre amour et devoir.

programme.title: Talk To Me
programme.desc: Une productrice de talk-show idéaliste se heurte à son patron obsédé par les audiences sur une histoire impliquant une jeune prostituée.

programme.title: Bruce Lee: Immortal Dragon
programme.desc: Un regard sur la vie de la superstar Bruce Lee.

programme.title: Braquage à New York
programme.desc: Henry, un percepteur de péage, est injustement emprisonné après avoir aidé sans le savoir des amis à commettre un vol de banque. En prison, il se lie d'amitié avec Max, un escroc charmant. Après avoir purgé sa peine, Henry découvre un vieux tunnel reliant la banque à un théâtre.

programme.title: Grey Lady
programme.desc: Après le meurtre de sa partenaire policière et amante à Boston, le détective James Doyle, détective criminel, suit un indice dans ses derniers mots qui le mène sur l'île isolée de Nantucket, à la recherche de son assassin, pendant la morte-saison.

programme.title: La veuve de Saint-Pierre
programme.desc: Dans une petite colonie française, un homme ivre tue quelqu'un. Pendant qu'une guillotine est en cours d'acheminement, il change, devenant un homme bon et populaire.

programme.title: Un autre monde
programme.desc: 1915... A la mort de sa mère, Louis débarque sur l'île de la Réunion pour rencontrer son père le comte de Kerdiguen. L'ile est alors agitée par la mobilisation pour le front. Des planteurs, soutenus par le gouverneur et l'église, tentent d'empêcher le départ de leur main d'oeuvre noire.

programme.title: Le Pacte des copines
programme.desc: Abandonnée devant l'autel, Ella part en lune de miel avec son amie Lindsey, qui cache son amour pour un homme.

programme.title: L'Édition de l'Amour
programme.desc: Une rédactrice beauté persuade un photographe de simuler une relation, mais des sentiments réels naissent.

programme.title: La playlist de l'amour
programme.desc: Amanda collabore avec Sam pour une soirée du lancement, ignorant qu'il est l'homme qu'elle fréquente en ligne.

programme.title: L'amour en coffret
programme.desc: Lillian conseille la start-up de Grant, mais son passé amoureux risque de chambouler ses sentiments.

programme.title: Innocent
programme.desc: Dans cette séquelle du film Présumé innocent de Scott Turow, le juge Rusty Sabich (Pullman) se retrouve à nouveau au centre d'une enquête pour meurtre lorsqu'il est accusé du meurtre de sa femme.

programme.title: Savior
programme.desc: Un mercenaire endurci de la Légion étrangère commence à trouver sa propre humanité lorsqu'il est confronté à des atrocités pendant la guerre en Bosnie.

programme.title: Voyeur
programme.desc: Un couple emménage dans une petite ville et découvre vite que le diacre de l'église locale les épie via surveillance vidéo. Ils en parlent aux autorités et découvrent qu'il n'y a pas de loi protégeant les gens contre le fait filmés chez eux.

programme.title: Une affaire de coeur
programme.desc: Audrey Woods et Daniel Rafferty, deux avocats réputés en droit du divorce ont vu au fil des procès l'amour tourner au vinaigre. Pourrait-il en être autrement pour eux ? Au sommet de leur carrière, tout les oppose. Audrey pratique le droit en suivant les règles à la lettre, alors que Daniel se permet tous les coups possibles et inimaginables pour gagner. Bientôt, ils s'affrontent lors d'un méchant divorce public entre des clients célèbres dont le point de discorde est un château en Irlande.

programme.title: Le prince et moi
programme.desc: Paige découvre avec stupeur que l'homme dont elle est tombée amoureuse est un prince. Les choses se compliquent lorsque le roi renonce à son rôle et force alors son amoureux à prendre le trône. Paige doit maintenant prendre une décision difficile : suivre sa carrière ou son cœur.

programme.title: John and the Hole
programme.desc: John ressemble à tous les collégiens de son âge. En famille aussi, il se sent bien… Un jour, il découvre au fond de son jardin un vieux bunker. Contre toute attente, il décide d'y enfermer sa sœur et ses parents après les avoir sédatés.

programme.title: Manipulation : la voisine dà côté
programme.desc: Alors que Doug a une liaison avec Lena, la jeune femme qui a loué la maison voisine de la sienne pour l'été, la mort suspecte du mari de cette dernière révèle l'existence d'une assurance vie conséquente.

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Une bande d'arnaqueurs talentueux dotés de superpouvoirs tente de dévaliser un énorme casino, mais c'est sans compter sur un mystérieux rival qui semble tous les surpasser…

programme.title: Secousse Sismique
programme.desc: Charley Baxter découvre qu'un tremblement de terre géant va annihiler le nord de l'Atlantique. Il doit désormais travailler avec le Dr Amy Lane, sismologue, afin d'arrêter le gouffre qui menace de couper l'Amérique et le reste du monde en deux.

programme.desc: Retrouvez tous les dossiers spéciaux sur le cinéma et les séries.

programme.desc: Les moments les plus mémorables du cinéma et des célébrités sont classés dans cette émission captivante.

programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.desc: Mini land-bound oceans, lakes are a treasure trove of aquatic wonders. Lakes make up just 3% of the Earth's surface, but they hold 180,000 square kilometres of fresh water. They can be anything from sanctuary from land predators and temperature regulators to bountiful food sources and pit-stops for migrating birdlife. Take a deep breath and dive into the magical world of lakes!

programme.title: The Power of Plants Race to Grow and Breed
programme.desc: Just like animals, the lives of plants are dominated by the need to become strong and pass on genes to the next generation – a race to grow and breed. They must race to beat their competition to the best light spots, and to make the most of perilously short seasons. And also like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on. Our ideas about plants need a seed change – it's time to respect the power of plants.

programme.title: The Power of Plants The Great Escape
programme.desc: You think plants are boring or passive? Far from it! They use complex reactions to respond to light, sound and touch. And like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on. Plants have evolved tricks to beat the ele-ments, animal enemies or even other plants: From thorns and spines to poisons and even live-in bodyguards. This two-part series shows the survival strategies of our green “roommates” we share the planet with.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Lake Iseo is located on the southern foothills of the Alps. It extends over the provinces of Brescia and Bergamo in the northern mainland of Italy. In the middle of Lake Iseo lies the largest island of the southern European inland waters. Monte Isola, as the island is called after its central mountain lies close to its two neighboring islands, Isola di San Paolo and Isola di Loreto. As early as the 11th century, a monastic association of Benedictines settled here. For many Italians, Lake Iseo is the most beautiful spot in their homeland. It is all the more astonishing how little the influence of tourism is here. Driving is strictly forbidden on the three islands, and only on Monte Isola. Only on Monte Isola there is a regular bus service in the summertime. Thus, the three islands are an oasis of an oasis of tranquility most of the year. The historical buildings and the nature remind of the long tradition in which the Italians have cultivated this retreat. Only every five years in the autumn a big celebration takes place. Then over 200,000 paper flowers decorate the island. The flowers are reminiscent of the time in the Middle Ages when a Roma woman brought her son to the island to be cured from the from the rampant plague. In gratitude, she donated a sea of flowers. The Festa di Santa Croce has been one of the main attractions in northern Italy ever since. The days are radiant with color, it is the only time when it gets crowded in the small streets of the island villages. The next festival was celebrated in September 2021.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Far from the glamour and spotlight of Lampedusa, Pantelleria is one of the best kept secrets among the Italian islands. Located closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria has been nicknamed "The Last Island," a title also given by Giosuè Calaciura gave to his 2016 historical novel set on Pantelleria. Pantelleria, that is the island of lava, capers and of the liqueur wine that comes here Zibibbo. An island with an ancient history, where for centuries farmers and fishermen have pursued their craft. their craft. The famous Zibibbo grapes are cultivated here - among other things also on the vineyard that Gerard Depardieu and his wife Carole Bouquet bought to produce traditional liqueur and nutmeg wine themselves and distribute it worldwide. The cuisine of the island is as much Arabic as Italian, couscous with fish is a typical island dish.

programme.title: Hot Roads

programme.desc: The Canadian ice roads exist only for a few months in the winter when the ice is thick enough. The only time of the year when goods can be transported up to Northern Manitoba. We accompany the truckers Vlad and Hugh as well as the aboriginal Canadian Scott with his pick-up on their long journey to a village called God's Lake. A risky trip in icy temperatures, sometimes even below - 60 degrees Celcius. The men are in constant danger of getting stuck and need to forget everything they ever learnt about driving on a highway in order to arrive safely.

programme.title: Predators of a Different Kind
programme.sub-title: In the World of the Unknown Sharks
programme.desc: With the aid of modern technology, reveal the unknown behaviour of some unusual species of shark: lemon sharks and their white-tip reef counterparts. Our film trip begins on the Bahamas. To be more precise: in the turquoise-blue waters of the Grand Bahama Bank, in an exactly fixed location. In the spring, 70 – 80 pregnant lemon sharks arrive here. This huge shark population was first discovered just a few years ago by shark researcher, Professor Sam Gruber. Many of the females are tired and rest on the seabed. Pregnant tiger sharks swim in the midst of this group. Without any protection whatsoever, our cameramen shoot their footage, surrounded by sharks and succeed in capturing images hitherto unseen. We continue our journey to Gainesville, Florida, to meet Gordon Hubbell, the leading shark denture expert with the world's largest shark denture collection. He knows everything about the evolutionary history of the lemon sharks, in addition to those of the white-tip reef variety off Cocos Island, Costa Rica. Here, we encounter large schools of fish, unprecedented numbers of stingrays, as well as hammerhead sharks. However, it is the white-tip reek sharks that make the biggest impression. Their performance begins late at night. Marauding, they patrol in large groups through the reefs and hunt everything that moves. Scales and dead prey fish float above the reef – a welcoming change of diet for the ubiquitous barracudas.

programme.title: mareTV: Majorca
programme.desc: "Cleaning woman island", concrete castles, Ballermann: Mallorca's image is negatively affected in some respects. The documentary explores the charm of the largest Balearic island beyond the hustle and bustle of tourism and Rambazamba. The "real" Mallorca is best explored through real Majorcans: Manolo Barahona, TV fishing expert from the local island broadcaster IB3, faces the most difficult task of the year. The Raor is in season, the most expensive fish on the island. Manolo is supposed to get him first in front of the camera and then in the pan. There's only one catch, the little fish with the piranha teeth just doesn't want to be on TV. In the first months of the year Mallorca turns into a sea of almond blossoms. There are around seven million almond trees on the island, once planted to replace dead vines. But now also the almond trees are threatened. The fire bacterium continues to spread, especially on the large plantations. The farmer Biel Torrens wants to save Mallorca's almond trees and fruit with a small organic plantation and gentle harvesting methods. He shakes the almonds from the tree by hand instead of using a mechanical vibrator.

programme.title: Europe's Forgotten Pilgrim Routes
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, the horrifying murder of Archbishop Thomas Becket of Canterbury led thousands of pilgrims to the south of England. Centuries later, the long-forgotten Pilgrims' Way is now enjoying a revival. The Pilgrim´s Way leads east to west cross-country from Winchester to Canterbury through the counties of Hampshire, Surrey and Kent. Along the way, modern pilgrims discover traces of the past and the pristine beauty of the land. They meet people who want to preserve England's rich natural treasures and traditions for the future.

programme.title: Europe's Forgotten Pilgrim Routes
programme.desc: In honour of the Archangel Michael, thousands of medieval Christians set off on pilgrimages to the famous mountain monastery of the Mont-Saint-Michel in the Atlantic Ocean. Today it continues to enchant millions of visitors each year. But the pilgrimage route from Rouen to the mountain abbey seems to have been forgotten: it leads through the depths of Normandy into rural France. Modern pilgrims can expect a fascinating voyage of discovery along historic paths that will allow them to discover not only the original character of the country and its inhabitants, but also themselves.

programme.title: Europe's Forgotten Pilgrim Routes
programme.desc: For centuries, pilgrims have set off on the Via Francigena in the hopes of reaching the tombs of the apostles Peter and Paul in Rome. The ancient pilgrimage route leads through the imposing Alps to the Great St Bernard Pass and from there cross-country through Italy: along the Aosta Valley and the endless rice fields of the Po Valley, over the mountains of the Apennines, and the rolling hills of Tuscany to Lazio – en route, modern pilgrims discover Italy's majestic and diverse landscapes, as well as traces of bygone eras. Along the way, they meet people who share with them their enthusiasm for the country and the tradition of pilgrimage.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: MasterJi In The Newsroom
programme.desc: In the first episode of Master Ji in the Newsroom, Avadh Ojha explains why European powers—Portuguese, French, Dutch, and British—all set sail for India around the same time in the 15th century. He breaks down why India was called the "Sone ki Chidiya," the mistakes that led to colonization, and how the British went from spice traders to rulers.

programme.title: Sansad Mein Aaj
programme.desc: BJP is demanding Punjab Education Minister Harjot Singh Bains's resignation over alleged exam irregularities, following Dharmendra Pradhan's exit over the NEET paper leak. CM Bhagwant Mann denies any leak, but the opposition is ramping up pressure ahead of Punjab elections.

programme.title: Netanagri
programme.desc: In the first segment of Netanagri, Kuldeep Mishra discusses why the opposition is demanding Amit Shah's resignation over the pellet gun issue. The episode also covers Congress' strategy, Shehzad Poonawalla's BJP exit rumours, and the debate around Dharmendra Pradhan.

programme.title: The Lallantop
programme.desc: In today's The Lallantop Show, Kuldeep breaks down Prashant Kishor's game-changing Bankipur victory and the BJP's unexpected loss in Datia. We also cover Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh's acquittal in the sexual harassment case, and the introduction of two key bills—the Indian Statistical Institute Bill and the Bankers' Books Evidence Bill—in the Lok Sabha amid opposition protests over police action .

programme.title: Duniyadari
programme.desc: In today's Duniyadari, US President Trump says negotiations with Iran will resume Monday after calling off a planned attack, while Israel strikes Gaza killing 19 despite ceasefire claims. Also covered: PoK election disruptions, Sheikh Hasina's first public address since ouster, and Japan-US joint intervention to prop up the yen.

programme.title: Kharcha Pani
programme.desc: State-run oil companies reported combined losses of ₹18,149 crore for the June quarter—far lower than the government's ₹75,000 crore estimate . In this episode of Kharcha Pani, Shruti breaks down the gap, India's Russian oil imports, and SEBI's new stock market rules.

programme.title: Rajdhani
programme.desc: Prashant Kishor's victory in Bankipur is being seen as a political earthquake that goes far beyond a single by-election. Coming after the Gen Z protests at Jantar Mantar, the result has delivered a strong message to the BJP, RJD, and Bihar's political establishment.

programme.title: Sansad Mein Aaj
programme.desc: In today's Sansad Mein Aaj, we cover the Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Bill passed in the Lok Sabha without debate, the ₹47,100 collected by Samajwadi Party MPs from their donation box protest, Priyanka Gandhi's protest over lathi-charge on students, and the MSME Amendment Bill passed in the Rajya Sabha amid opposition uproar and Kharge's argument with the Chairman.

programme.title: Sehat
programme.desc: In today's Sehat show, we cover monsoon eye infections, excessive hair fall during the rainy season, and the roti vs rice debate for blood sugar control. Experts Dr. Mayank Tomar, Dr. Govind Bhartiya, and Dr. Abhinav Kumar Gupta join us with practical tips.

programme.title: The Cinema Show
programme.desc: In today's The Cinema Show, we cover the passing of Sopranos actor Vincent Pastore, Spider-Man: Brand New Day's historic ₹306 crore first-week collection, and the ₹50 crore music rights deal of Shah Rukh Khan's King. Plus, updates on Mirzapur: The Movie, Akshay Kumar's R.D. Burman biopic, and much more.

programme.title: UP Bulletin
programme.desc: Former WFI chief Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh and Vinod Tomar have been acquitted by Delhi's Rouse Avenue Court in the sexual harassment case filed by women wrestlers . programme.title: LIVE GURBANI KIRTAN FROM GURUDWARA SRI SIS GANJ SAHIB
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Shabad Amrit
programme.desc: Shabad Amrit is a soulful devotional songs slot dedicated to the divine verses of Gurbani. The segment features a curated selection of sacred Shabads and spiritual hymns that inspire peace, reflection, and inner harmony. Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: Desi Beatz
programme.desc: From foot-tapping beats to soulful melodies, Desi Beatz showcases a dynamic mix of popular artists, fresh releases, and trending music videos that reflect the pulse of today's Punjabi youth. The show captures the essence of modern Punjab—where tradition meets contemporary sound—making it a perfect blend of rhythm, style, and desi swag. Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. Tune in to GTC Punjabi Television and stay connected with what's trending in Punjabi music—loud, lively, and full of desi energy.

programme.title: Surtaaj of Punjab
programme.desc: “Surtaaj of Punjab” is a vibrant Punjabi musical reality show on GTC Punjabi, celebrating the rich cultural heritage of Punjab through its aspiring singers. Hosted by Saira, Anmol Aulakh and Gurjeet Singh, the show features a diverse range of talent competing for the coveted title. Renowned music directors Gurmeet Singh and Jaidev Kumar (Music Director) along with celebrated singer Jyotika Tangri, serve as the esteemed judges, guiding contestants on a musical journey. Each episode is a celebration of talent, emotion, and the magic of Punjabi music.

programme.title: Dharma Sandehalu | Kakunuri Suryanarayana

The work urges individuals to think critically, act responsibly, and align moral values with social progress and human welfare.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

This stunning centerpiece dish may take a while to prepare but it is guaranteed to bring the holiday cheer to your dinner table.
